inspection.reviewer: Codex direct image inspection: all 52 final states plus representative baseline combat and all baseline meta states
findings: Final decoy ring and label, actual +2 HP feedback, expiry, and visible projectile fan reviewed in both themes, both render packs, and 390/1440 viewports.

One free shop offer becomes paid after redemption with unchanged coin balance; Gauntlet bonus perk opens once and resolves. All 20 final meta captures have zero page errors or horizontal document overflow.

Both baseline and final Gauntlet captures show pre-existing arena sizing and clipped world-space toast artifacts. These are outside the changed perk modal and remain a recorded follow-up, not a claim of full-site visual perfection.
Disabled unaffordable shop rows remain deliberately dim. The selected free offer and perk choices are legible and reachable.

Synthetic local ownership and live-state fixture acceleration establish runtime behavior; these captures are not participant playtest evidence. Volley survivor count can decrease after obstacle collision; initial three-shot behavior is separately regression tested.
fixesApplied: Free offers now show free-item guidance instead of normal-price warnings.
Decoy placement includes arena edge inset and explicit DECOY label.
Volley screenshots allow shots to clear the boss silhouette before capture.
inspection.scope: Changed boss effects, free shop offers and opening perk flow. Existing Gauntlet arena clipping recorded separately.
